gloss: to be in time, to make it

definitions.gloss: to be in time for, to make it
definitions.explanation: To arrive or complete something before a deadline or scheduled time.

definitions.gloss: to be sufficient, to serve the purpose
definitions.explanation: For something to be adequate or good enough for a purpose.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}に{間|ま}に{合|あ}った。
examples.english: I made it in time for the train.

examples.japanese: {締|し}め{切|き}りに{間|ま}に{合|あ}わない。
これで{間|ま}に{合|あ}いますか。
{急|いそ}げばギリギリ{間|ま}に{合|あ}うと{思|おも}うけど、{遅|おく}れないように{出|で}よう。
examples.english: I think we can barely make it if we hurry, but let's leave so we're not late.
examples.notes: ギリギリ = barely, just in time

examples.japanese: {今|いま}あるもので{間|ま}に{合|あ}わせるしかない。{新|あたら}しいのを{買|か}う{時間|じかん}がない。
examples.english: We have no choice but to make do with what we have. There's no time to buy new ones.
examples.notes: 間に合わせる = to make do with

examples.japanese: {飛行機|ひこうき}に{間|ま}に{合|あ}うかな？
examples.notes: Sense 1: to be in time for

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}に{間|ま}に{合|あ}わなかった。
examples.english: I didn't make it to the meeting in time.

examples.japanese: この{量|りょう}で{間|ま}に{合|あ}う。
{古|ふる}いパソコンでも{間|ま}に{合|あ}う。
これで{間|ま}に{合|あ}わせよう。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pattern: Xに{間|ま}に{合|あ}う (be in time for X).

ASPECT: ている is less common. Usually used in past or potential form.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{電車|でんしゃ}に{間|ま}に{合|あ}う (make the train)
・{締|し}め{切|き}りに{間|ま}に{合|あ}う (meet the deadline)
・{間|ま}に{合|あ}わない (won't make it)
・{間|ま}に{合|あ}わせる (make do, manage with)
・ギリギリ{間|ま}に{合|あ}う (barely make it)

COMPOUND VERB: {間|ま}に (in time) + {合|あ}う (to match/meet)

RELATED:
・{間|ま}に{合|あ}わせ (makeshift, improvised—noun)
・{間|ま}に{合|あ}わせる (to make do with)
